description: Acterys Reporting is a powerful Power BI financial reporting visual that transforms how finance teams present, analyze, and collaborate on data. With support for IBCS-compliant reporting in Power BI, this visual allows you to build professional, consistent reports—without writing complex DAX formulas. From variance analysis in Power BI to rich text commenting and write-back support, Acterys Reporting provides full flexibility for analysts and CFOs who need more from their visuals. With built-in financial statement formatting features and centralized styling options, reports look consistent, clean, and ready for boardrooms. Ideal for FP&A, strategy, and operations teams, this custom Power BI visual for finance integrates seamlessly with Acterys' planning capabilities for an all-in-one reporting and decision-making solution. Key Features: Custom Row and Column Calculations: Add Gross Margin, EBIT, and other metrics using spreadsheet-style logic directly in Power BI. IBCS-Compliant Variance Visualization: Display variances in absolute/relative terms using customizable waterfall charts and comparison columns. Rich Text Commenting: Add row- or cell-level narratives to highlight assumptions or insights, ideal for collaboration and audit trails.
